notes: Identity verified from supplied text title page: Disentangling Professional Competence and Foreign Accent; Cesar Teló, Pavel Trofimovich, Mary Grantham O’Brien; 2022; DOI 10.1075/jslp.22013.tel. The supplied candidate is a full primary manuscript with methods, results, references and appendices (43 numbered pages), not an abstract or secondary report. No PDF was supplied. Only es_value_o is assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. Tables label the coefficient column Estimate, not standardized beta. Section 4.4 (pp. 13–14) specifies a binomial distribution with a logit link. No effect-size conversion performed. The same-row printed test is Speaker L1 × Prestige × Skill         –0.99        0.12   [–1.23, –0.74]   –8.03   < .001. The target is the three-way parameter explicitly identified by the interaction description and table locator. Skill is the table label for performance level (Figure captions explicitly say performance (skill) level). The subsequent narrative describes low-performance simple contrasts using ORs; these are follow-up tests rather than the three-way coefficient.
